page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number left and title right. Main text in one column, right of a narrow left margin. Left margin holds one note ("Heb.9.22.") beside the line "quit Apostolus". Catchword at foot right ("oppo-" is a line of text, not a catchword).

main_text.p: Christi sacrificium : Tum esse Christi naturale denuò destrueretur ; Tum finiti valoris foret (animus horret cogitare) sanguis mediatoris. Imo Christus ipse non in mensa sacrificavit, sed in cruce ; Etenim si perfectum in coena suâ sacrificium obtulit, pleneque propitiatorium, quid opus illi erat mori post-modùm? Quorsum illi in cruce effusus cruor, qui transsubstantiato illo necdum emisso sanguine mundum priùs redemisset? Quod si incruentum, tum non propitiatorium : Nulla enim (inquit Apostolus) Heb.9.22. χωρὶς αἱματεκχυσίας remissio. Aut quæ demùm oppo-

page.notes: Greek phrase "χωρὶς αἱματεκχυσίας" is printed in Greek; transcribed as closely as the scan allows. Lower-right word "oppo-" is a line-end hyphenated word, not a catchword; a faint ghost of "Christi" appears in the bottom margin and is show-through, omitted. Some words in the line "Christi sacrificium" region are faint and may be imperfect.
